en.text: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 那时，有法利赛人和文士从耶路撒冷来见耶稣，说：

zhTraditional.text: 那時，有法利賽人和文士從耶路撒冷來見耶穌，說：

en.text: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

zhSimplified.text: 「你的门徒为什么犯古人的遗传呢？因为吃饭的时候，他们不洗手。」

zhTraditional.text: 「你的門徒為甚麼犯古人的遺傳呢？因為吃飯的時候，他們不洗手。」

en.text: He answered them, “Whydo you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「你们为什么因着你们的遗传犯 神的诫命呢？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「你們為甚麼因着你們的遺傳犯上帝的誡命呢？

en.text: ForGod commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

zhSimplified.text: 神说：『当孝敬父母』；又说：『咒骂父母的，必治死他。』

zhTraditional.text: 上帝說：『當孝敬父母』；又說：『咒罵父母的，必治死他。』

en.text: Butyou say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

zhSimplified.text: 你们倒说：『无论何人对父母说：我所当奉给你的已经作了供献，

zhTraditional.text: 你們倒說：『無論何人對父母說：我所當奉給你的已經作了供獻，

en.text: heshall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

zhSimplified.text: 他就可以不孝敬父母。』这就是你们借着遗传，废了 神的诫命。

zhTraditional.text: 他就可以不孝敬父母。』這就是你們藉着遺傳，廢了上帝的誡命。

en.text: Youhypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 假冒为善的人哪，以赛亚指着你们说的预言是不错的。他说：

zhTraditional.text: 假冒為善的人哪，以賽亞指着你們說的預言是不錯的。他說：

en.text: ‘Thesepeople draw near to me with their mouth, andhonor me with their lips; buttheir heart is far from me.

zhSimplified.text: 这百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我；

zhTraditional.text: 這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心卻遠離我；

en.text: Andthey worship me in vain, teachingas doctrine rules made by men.’”

zhSimplified.text: 他们将人的吩咐当作道理教导人， 所以拜我也是枉然。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人， 所以拜我也是枉然。」

en.text: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, andunderstand.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣就叫了众人来，对他们说：「你们要听，也要明白。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌就叫了眾人來，對他們說：「你們要聽，也要明白。

en.text: Thatwhich enters into the mouth doesn’ t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

zhSimplified.text: 入口的不能污秽人，出口的乃能污秽人。」

zhTraditional.text: 入口的不能污穢人，出口的乃能污穢人。」

en.text: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

zhSimplified.text: 当时，门徒进前来对他说：「法利赛人听见这话，不服，你知道吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 當時，門徒進前來對他說：「法利賽人聽見這話，不服，你知道嗎？」

en.text: But he answered, “Everyplant which my heavenly Father didn’ t plant will be uprooted.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「凡栽种的物，若不是我天父栽种的，必要拔出来。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「凡栽種的物，若不是我天父栽種的，必要拔出來。

en.text: Leave themalone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

zhSimplified.text: 任凭他们吧！他们是瞎眼领路的；若是瞎子领瞎子，两个人都要掉在坑里。」

zhTraditional.text: 任憑他們吧！他們是瞎眼領路的；若是瞎子領瞎子，兩個人都要掉在坑裏。」

en.text: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得对耶稣说：「请将这比喻讲给我们听。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得對耶穌說：「請將這比喻講給我們聽。」

en.text: So Jesus said, “Doyou also still not understand?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们到如今还不明白吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們到如今還不明白嗎？

en.text: Don’tyou understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

zhSimplified.text: 岂不知凡入口的，是运到肚子里，又落在茅厕里吗？

zhTraditional.text: 豈不知凡入口的，是運到肚子裏，又落在茅廁裏嗎？

en.text: Butthe things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

zhSimplified.text: 惟独出口的，是从心里发出来的，这才污秽人。

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨出口的，是從心裏發出來的，這才污穢人。

en.text: Forout of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

zhSimplified.text: 因为从心里发出来的，有恶念、凶杀、奸淫、苟合、偷盗、妄证、谤 。

zhTraditional.text: 因為從心裏發出來的，有惡念、凶殺、姦淫、苟合、偷盜、妄證、謗讟。

en.text: Theseare the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’ t defile the man.”

zhSimplified.text: 这都是污秽人的；至于不洗手吃饭，那却不污秽人。」 （可7·24—30）

zhTraditional.text: 這都是污穢人的；至於不洗手吃飯，那卻不污穢人。」 （可7‧24－30）

en.text: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣离开那里，退到泰尔、西顿的境内去。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌離開那裏，退到泰爾、西頓的境內去。

en.text: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

zhSimplified.text: 有一个迦南妇人，从那地方出来，喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我！我女儿被鬼附得甚苦。」

zhTraditional.text: 有一個迦南婦人，從那地方出來，喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我！我女兒被鬼附得甚苦。」

en.text: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣却一言不答。门徒进前来，求他说：「这妇人在我们后头喊叫，请打发她走吧。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌卻一言不答。門徒進前來，求他說：「這婦人在我們後頭喊叫，請打發她走吧。」

en.text: But he answered, “Iwasn’ t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我奉差遣不过是到以色列家迷失的羊那里去。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我奉差遣不過是到以色列家迷失的羊那裏去。」

en.text: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

zhSimplified.text: 那妇人来拜他，说：「主啊，帮助我！」

zhTraditional.text: 那婦人來拜他，說：「主啊，幫助我！」

en.text: But he answered, “Itis not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

zhSimplified.text: 他回答说：「不好拿儿女的饼丢给狗吃。」

zhTraditional.text: 他回答說：「不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。」

en.text: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

zhSimplified.text: 妇人说：「主啊，不错；但是狗也吃它主人桌子上掉下来的碎渣儿。」

zhTraditional.text: 婦人說：「主啊，不錯；但是狗也吃牠主人桌子上掉下來的碎渣兒。」

en.text: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.”And her daughter was healed from that hour.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「妇人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，给你成全了吧。」从那时候，她女儿就好了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「婦人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，給你成全了吧。」從那時候，她女兒就好了。

en.text: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣离开那地方，来到靠近加利利的海边，就上山坐下。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌離開那地方，來到靠近加利利的海邊，就上山坐下。

en.text: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

zhSimplified.text: 有许多人到他那里，带着瘸子、瞎子、哑巴、有残疾的，和好些别的病人，都放在他脚前；他就治好了他们。

zhTraditional.text: 有許多人到他那裏，帶着瘸子、瞎子、啞巴、有殘疾的，和好些別的病人，都放在他腳前；他就治好了他們。

en.text: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 甚至众人都希奇；因为看见哑巴说话，残疾的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看见，他们就归荣耀给以色列的 神。 （可8·1—10）

zhTraditional.text: 甚至眾人都希奇；因為看見啞巴說話，殘疾的痊癒，瘸子行走，瞎子看見，他們就歸榮耀給以色列的上帝。 （可8‧1－10）

en.text: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “Ihave compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’ t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣叫门徒来，说：「我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。我不愿意叫他们饿着回去，恐怕在路上困乏。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裏已經三天，也沒有吃的了。我不願意叫他們餓着回去，恐怕在路上困乏。」

en.text: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

zhSimplified.text: 门徒说：「我们在这野地，哪里有这么多的饼叫这许多人吃饱呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 門徒說：「我們在這野地，哪裏有這麼多的餅叫這許多人吃飽呢？」

en.text: Jesus said to them, “Howmany loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们有多少饼？」他们说：「有七个，还有几条小鱼。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「有七個，還有幾條小魚。」

en.text: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

zhSimplified.text: 他就吩咐众人坐在地上，

zhTraditional.text: 他就吩咐眾人坐在地上，

en.text: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

zhSimplified.text: 拿着这七个饼和几条鱼，祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒；门徒又递给众人。

zhTraditional.text: 拿着這七個餅和幾條魚，祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒；門徒又遞給眾人。

en.text: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

zhSimplified.text: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，收拾剩下的零碎，装满了七个筐子。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，裝滿了七個筐子。

en.text: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

zhSimplified.text: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，共有四千。

zhTraditional.text: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，共有四千。

en.text: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣叫众人散去，就上船，来到马加丹的境界。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌叫眾人散去，就上船，來到馬加丹的境界。
